about.label: Ibyerekeye Reagle FX Empire
about.title: Kubaka Abacuruzi Batsinda n'Ubumuntu
about.story: CoachPeter yashinze Reagle FX Empire kugira ngo ahindure abatangira babe abacuruzi b'ibanze b'ibanze b'ibanze. Kuva i Kigali kugeza ku isi, ubuyobozi bwe buhuza ubunararibonye n'umuryango.
about.mission: Intego yacu ni ugushyira imbere uburezi bwa forex bwa professional — gukora imikoranire y'ikigo ishobora kuboneka kuri buri mcuruzi wifuza mu Afurika n'ahandi.
about.experience: Hamwe n'imyaka myinshi yo gucuruza isoko ry'ukuri n'abanyeshuri bakurikijwe mu bihe bigoye, CoachPeter atanga ubuyobozi bw'ukuri, bw'ukuri kandi bufite ibisubizo.
about.philosophy: Curura ufite gahunda. Rinda imari yawe. Kura n'umuryango. Niyo nzira ya Reagle FX Empire.

results.label: Ibisubizo Byemejwe
results.title: Inyungu Z'ukuri. Abanyeshuri B'ukuri. Ubwami Bw'ukuri.
results.subtitle: Inyungu za MT5, kubikuza byemejwe, n'intsinzi z'abanyeshuri mu muryango wa Reagle FX.
results.testimonial1: CoachPeter yahinduye uko mbona isoko. Navuye mu gutakaza kugeza ku nyungu z'icyumweru.
results.testimonial2: Inkunga y'umuryango ntiyigera igira uko. Amasomo azima n'ubunyangamugayo byatumye impinduka.
results.testimonial3: Reagle FX Empire yampaye imiterere, ubumuntu, n'ubwizewe bwo gucuruza forex.
